resources.string: A Web3 wallet is a cryptographic identity used to sign proofs and attestations. Privy creates and manages your wallet securely — no seed phrases needed.
The Ethereum Attestation Service (EAS) provides onchain attestations that cryptographically verify the authenticity of your proofs.
Privy is a secure authentication provider that creates seedless embedded wallets. Your private keys never leave Privy\'s sandboxed environment.
Proofmode uses a Web3 wallet to cryptographically sign every proof you capture, creating a verifiable chain of authenticity.
Privy creates and manages your wallet securely — no seed phrases or private keys to memorize. Authentication is as simple as email or SMS.
The Ethereum Attestation Service (EAS) anchors your proofs onchain, creating tamper-evident records that anyone can independently verify.
On-chain attestations use sponsored gas when available.
Self-funded mode — gas is paid from your wallet balance.
Override active. Clear field and save to use build default.

Sponsored transactions let Proofmode pay network gas for your on-chain attestations through ZeroDev when enabled.

When sponsorship is off or unavailable, attestations are self-funded: your wallet pays gas in the blockchain's native token.

On-chain actions are public and irreversible. If sponsorship fails, open this screen to check the project ID or disable sponsorship.
